name: azure-file-processing
description: Upload, process and query very large documents through Azure Blob Storage without their contents entering the model's context, and drive the Scyne requirements pipeline as tracked issues.

interface.shortDescription: Process huge files in Azure and run the Scyne pipeline, without filling the context window
interface.longDescription: Ships two MCP servers. The FILE plane provides an upload-process-retrieve workflow for documents up to 5 GiB: files travel directly from the machine into Azure Blob Storage using a short-lived, write-only SAS URL and are processed by a worker pool that streams them page by page, so a 2 GB PDF can be questioned while only a few kilobytes ever reach the context window. The WORKSPACE plane fronts the Scyne requirements pipeline: a stage started from Codex (capability map, personas, requirements, UI mockups, data model, architecture, test cases, the companion app) becomes the SAME tracked issue the chatbot creates — visible in the console, in Spend and in Actions — with its documents, projects and features synced durably to the same Azure Blob Storage the file plane uses.
defaultPrompt: Upload a large document to Azure, process it into page-mapped chunks, and answer my questions about it using only the passages that matter.
Run the capability map for my project and tell me when it needs approving.
